neighbours.label: infinitive ' be' after a modal or 'to', typically starting a passive (can be stored, should be taken, need to be submitted)
fire: Most fresh herbs can be dried in a warm, dark room.
The results will be announced at the end of the week.
Old batteries should be taken to a recycling center.
This form must be signed by both parents.
Leftover rice can be frozen in small bags.
The tickets may be collected at the box office.
Applications need to be submitted before Friday.
The engine has to be cooled before you open the cap.
